purpose: Fifty raw workers managed as a reusable execution pool. Intelligence is delegated per task; workers do not own reasoning authority.
invariants: RAW_BOT describes the reusable worker shape; it is never a terminal lifecycle state.
One active task and one assigned scope per raw bot.
Every completed task must emit an observation, evidence, validation result, learned task short name, and upgrade target.
A learned task identity is promoted only from validated task evidence.
Every bot carries one numeric upgradePriority (1-100; 100 is the highest upgrade urgency) and one best current weakness target.
After every task the controller must reassess weakness and either specialize, upgrade, become ready, or recycle the bot.
Knowledge never bypasses exact-SHA or canonical CI proof.

lifecycle.rule: Every completed task must produce a learned task identity and an upgrade target; no bot may settle in RAW/UNPROVISIONED.

upgradeModel.specializationRule: learned short name becomes the current task identity only after validation

taskExecutionModel.universalTaskRule: Any bot may receive any admitted project task; learned specialization changes routing priority, not task eligibility.
taskExecutionModel.scopeRule: Execution remains limited to the exact task scope delegated by the control plane.
taskExecutionModel.reuseRule: After task closure the bot returns to the reusable pool with its learned knowledge retained.

personalMemory.rule: The personal file stores learned knowledge for that bot; the aggregate index is derived for discovery/routing.

cellCouncil.mutationRule: No seat mutates the cell directly; mutations are enacted only by the canonical execution path under assistantController.

actionRepairCohort.purpose: Five standing Actions-repair workers: historical solution extraction, canonical wake coordination, twin A, twin B, and deterministic best-option selection.
